newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-SCIFO RETURNING TO ANDERLECHT AFTER 10 YEARS AWAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCIFO RETURNING TO ANDERLECHT AFTER 10 YEARS AWAY.

text.p: Belgium midfielder Enzo Scifo said on Thursday he was happy to be returning to his first club Anderlecht at the end of the season after 10 years abroad.
The Belgian club announced on Wednesday that the 31-year-old Monaco player had agreed a three-year contract with an option to join the board afterwards.
"It's true, I wanted to leave (Monaco) and the contacts I had with the directors of the club (Anderlecht) were good," Scifo said.
"It's the club I wanted to return to, the club of my heart."
Although UEFA Cup quarter-finalists Monaco refused to make any official statement, coach Jean Tigana seemed happy to let Scifo go.
"He's a great professional. If he's decided it in his head, nothing can stop him from going," Tigana said.
Scifo's decision comes after he has lost a regular place in the first team despite recovering from a toe injury that kept him out for most of the first half of the season.
Ali Benarbia has run the midfield in the absence of the Belgian in Monaco's surge to the top of the French first division.
